verdict.rationale: Whether a product's own source is available under an open license is a fair question for a code-hosting SaaS, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence shows Bitbucket's own source is published under an open license. The community comments about browsing source code concern users' repositories on Bitbucket, not the product's own code.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
